title: Aggregation
description: Combining or dissolving a unit - eggs into ten-packs, cartons onto a pallet. Corresponds to the EPCIS AggregationEvent (action ADD or DELETE). The subject of the entry is the parent unit; the components are listed in children.

container.description: The container itself, e.g. the carton or the pallet.

children.description: The units contained. The upper limit matches core.MaxParents: more than a thousand components in one step is no longer a real event.
